prompt: A warm painted animated film in the same elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous locked-off medium shot. Preserve the characters, faces, adult proportions, clothing, warm lighting, painted texture and fixed kitchen from the reference. Natural restrained human motion at normal speed. Stable solid objects with clearly separated hands and surfaces. The chef holds a few pear peelings above the chopping board, to the left of the open ceramic waste bowl. Keeping the same firm grip, she carries the peelings laterally through the clear air until her hand is centred above the bowl opening. She pauses above the opening, then gently opens her fingers and lets the peelings fall vertically into the bowl. Her hand never descends below the rim. The nearby tablet remains untouched. Her empty hand stays above the rim, then moves back through the clear air to rest beside the chopping board. The bowl and board stay fixed on the wooden bench. The other hand rests beside the cut fruit.
